lecnar.description: Automatically saves your VS Code session and offers a Restore button after a crash or shutdown: tabs, cursor position, Mental Beacon and reference web pages.
lecnar.command.addWebPage: Lecnar: Add Web Page to Context
lecnar.config.beaconDuration: Seconds the Mental Beacon stays lit.
lecnar.config.autosaveDelay: Seconds to wait after a change before auto-saving the session.
lecnar.config.enableVoice: Read a spoken summary (Audio Briefing) aloud when restoring the session. macOS only.
